task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to ensure that the gate is open. And then, attempt to go to the south. Once you do that, ensure that the hatch inside the kitchen is open. And then, make an attempt to travel south. After that, open the gateway. After that, take a trip south. Once you accomplish that, make an attempt to move west. After that, go north. With that accomplished, head west. After that, pick up the sandwich from the cabinet. And if you do that, you're the winner!
